PhysicalDamageCollision3D v3.1 - FD3D protocol vendor replacement

Build command:
  make clean && make all && make run

Compiler flags:
  -std=c89 -pedantic-errors -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2

Result:
  OK: all library objects compiled.
  OK: all demos linked.
  OK: all demos ran.

FD3D vendor replacement:
  include/fd3d89.h replaced with fdata3d89_protocol_patched/include/fd3d89.h
  src/vendor/framedata/fd3d89.c replaced with fdata3d89_protocol_patched/src/fd3d89.c

Protocol fixes included:
  FD3D_FX_FROM_INT(v) now uses multiplication instead of left-shifting signed input.
  FD3D_ArenaAlloc(arena, size, 0) now uses default long alignment.
  FD3D_ArenaAlloc rejects non-power-of-two non-zero alignments.
  PDC3D<->FD3D fixed-point bridge now avoids left-shifting signed negative values.
  PDC3D public fixed-point macros now avoid left-shifting signed negative values.
  PDC3D internal bridge conversions to grab/throw/weakspot/defense now avoid left-shifting signed negative values.
  HB3 integer conversion and fixed division avoid left-shifting signed negative values.

Demo output summary:
  zombie bite damage/weakspot OK
  swept blade hit OK
  arena scratch OK
  defense pipeline perfect parry/counter OK
  guard+shell+counter OK
  framedata i-frames/hitstop/stun/advantage OK
  protocol patch negative fixed-point roundtrip OK
